metadata.title: British Columbia government atlas — research companion
metadata.scope: Selected official-source research for the proposed historical government interface
metadata.integration_note: Local subject keys are proposed identifiers, not IDs from the user’s project. Review and map before import.
metadata.coverage_note: The user’s reported 242 ministry episodes, 1,236 ministerial terms and other totals were not comprehensively audited.
metadata.asset_note: No corporate logo masters, font files or original source documents are included.

sources.title: 2026 Provincial Election
sources.extract: Writ day; nomination deadline; advance voting; final voting day; planned final count; return day; 93 seats.
sources.caution: Future milestones are schedules, not outcomes. Final count is explicitly planned. Recheck before importing.

sources.title: Electoral History of B.C.
sources.extract: Historical chronology, including the October–December 1871 election and the introduction of party-line candidacies in 1903.
sources.caution: Use the electoral-history volumes for candidate-level records and voting-system details; this overview is not a complete election database.

sources.title: Provincial Election Results
sources.extract: Statements of Votes, DataBC results links, and Excel downloads for several older elections.
sources.caution: Apply corrections and errata. Election results are not subsequent caucus membership. Files are under the Elections BC Open Data Licence.

sources.title: Provincial By-election Results
sources.extract: Official entry point for by-election results to supplement general-election rosters.
sources.caution: Index located; a complete by-election extraction has not been performed.

sources.title: GIS Spatial Data
sources.extract: Electoral district and voting-area datasets; shape/KML resources and conversion/assignment tables through the BC Data Catalogue.
sources.caution: 2024 and 2020 resources are explicitly listed. Retain boundary vintage; do not assume complete digital coverage back to 1871. Not for official voter assignment.

sources.title: Library Publications and Collections
sources.extract: Fact-checked political lists; cabinet appointment lists; electoral-history volumes and errata; Holmes bibliography; digital publication search; MARC records.
sources.caution: Linked documents must be checked individually for revision dates and coverage. No comprehensive deputy-minister list was verified in this pass.
sources.locator: BC Political Facts; Cabinets; Library Publications

sources.title: Lieutenant Governors of British Columbia, 1871–Present
sources.extract: Official compiled list through Wendy Cocchia; distinguishes commission, appointment effective, swearing-in, and end of term; source notes.
sources.caution: Updated January 2025. The table numbers Cocchia 31; reconcile the user-reported total of 32 before editing. Do not copy parliamentary numbers without separate validation.

sources.title: Office of the Lieutenant Governor
sources.extract: Current incumbent cross-check: Wendy Cocchia; official office information.
sources.caution: A current website does not establish historical dates for prior incumbents.

sources.title: Legislative Library
sources.extract: Government-publication collections, catalogue and library contact route: library@leg.bc.ca.
sources.caution: Public research and reproduction requests are subject to service and access conditions; do not assume every item is digitized or available for loan.

sources.title: History of BC Parks
sources.extract: Strathcona Park legislation on 1911-03-01; 1957 Parks Branch within Recreation and Conservation, independent of the Forest Service.
sources.caution: 1911 is a parks-system/function milestone, not proof that today’s organization or name existed then. Do not use the page’s historical park totals as current statistics.

sources.title: Wildfire Governance
sources.publisher: Government of British Columbia / BC Wildfire Service
sources.extract: The service explicitly traces its formation to 1912; governance and mandate links.
sources.caution: Record this as the organization’s retrospective origin claim. It does not date adoption of the present name or logo.

sources.title: About the BC Wildfire Service
sources.extract: Six regional fire centres and links to governance, fire-centre information, historical seasons, statistics and geospatial data.
sources.caution: The six-centre count is a contemporary observation, not a historical constant. A fire-history page is not necessarily an organizational history.

sources.title: Our story
sources.extract: Official institutional history beginning in 1917; links to separate historical periods.
sources.caution: The reviewed page supports a year-level operational origin, not an exact day or a continuous responsible-minister assignment.

sources.extract: Logo changes in 1968 and 1983; Workmen’s to Workers’ Compensation Board name change in 1974; regional-office milestones.
sources.caution: These year-level logo dates do not verify vector artwork, exact rollout days, or complete retirement of the preceding mark.

sources.extract: Ralph McGinn appointment in 1998; David Anderson effective 2003-12-15; WorkSafeBC operating name in 2005; Diana Miles effective 2014-12-09.
sources.caution: Workers’ Compensation Board remains the legal name in the account. Exact retirement/appointment boundaries should be reconciled before generating full terms.

sources.title: News and Media
sources.extract: Official corporate-logo request route: media@bctransit.com; corporate photography and livery context.
sources.caution: A request route was verified, not an openly downloadable SVG or a permission grant for this project.

sources.title: Newsroom
sources.extract: Media contacts and link to an approved editorial media gallery.
sources.caution: A media gallery is not necessarily a logo pack or an unrestricted reuse licence.

sources.title: Media Gallery
sources.extract: Approved ICBC-related images and videos for editorial use.
sources.caution: Reviewed gallery examples were photos; no downloadable vector logo was verified.

sources.title: ICBC trademarks
sources.extract: Official trademark-information route linked from ICBC’s own site.
sources.caution: Retained as a rights-review route, not as evidence of permission for a logo generator.

sources.title: Media Centre
sources.extract: Official media contact route: mediarelations@bclc.com, with photo/video resources.
sources.caution: Request corporate and historical artwork explicitly. No open vector master verified.

sources.title: Photo and video gallery
sources.extract: Official imagery route with media terms and attribution conditions.
sources.caution: Gallery describes event/winner and casino/retail photography. Do not describe it as a confirmed logo download.

sources.title: Media Room
sources.extract: Official media library link and media@bcferries.com contact.
sources.caution: No vector master or historical-era dates verified. Corporate mark, vessel livery and historical government identity should be separate assets.
sources.locator: Media inquiries and BC Ferries media library

sources.title: British Columbia Railway Company (BCRC)
sources.extract: Current corridor/port-land mandate; former BC Rail infrastructure leased to CN; agreements, legislation and service-plan routes.
sources.caution: This current page does not resolve ministerial responsibility in 1972–2003. Do not equate the operating-railway transaction with disappearance of every legal entity.

sources.title: BC Archives collections and research services
sources.extract: Separate archival and library catalogues; government records; research help and reproductions.
sources.caution: Catalogue descriptions do not guarantee a digital image. Access and copying restrictions can be inherited from higher-level descriptions.

sources.title: Guides, Indexes and Inventories
sources.extract: Ministry history diagram; Sessional Papers index; city directories; colonial correspondence; finding aids.
sources.caution: These are discovery aids. Retrieve the underlying page or instrument before assigning a historical relationship.

sources.title: British Columbia Sessional Papers Index, 1872–1916
sources.extract: 119-page index; introduction describes colonial papers 1865–1871 and Assembly papers 1872–1982; report/title/page discovery.
sources.caution: The index is not the complete 1872–1982 collection. Session year can be one year later than report content. It cannot itself fill the later BC Rail or WCB periods.
sources.locator: PDF pp. 1–2, Introduction and Using the index

sources.title: Publications of the Government of British Columbia, 1871–1947 (Marjorie C. Holmes)
sources.extract: Department-arranged historical bibliography, linked from the Library publications page; useful for pre-1905 report discovery.
sources.caution: The 18.2 MB PDF exceeded the web tool’s fetch limit. Its listing and bibliographic purpose were verified; its full contents were not read.

sources.title: Orders in Council search and BC Laws guidance
sources.extract: Orders-in-Council search route, advanced-search and legislative date guidance.
sources.caution: Search results and individual historical instruments were not harvested. Separate instrument, filing and effective dates; retrieve the applicable historical version.

sources.title: Previous Budgets and Service Plan Reports
sources.extract: Budget links back to 1995; ministry plans from 2002; annual service-plan reports from 2001/02; later Crown plans.
sources.caution: Availability is an index observation, not proof of identical fields in every document. Preserve updated budgets and fiscal-year/reorganization comparability.

sources.title: Budget 2026 materials
sources.extract: Estimates, Supplement to Estimates, ministry plans and Crown agency plans, including proposed spending detail.
sources.caution: Proposed spending and budgeted staffing are not actual expenditure or headcount. No numeric staffing series was extracted in this pass.

sources.title: About FNHA
sources.extract: First Nations health governance and services formerly delivered by Health Canada; official reports and leadership routes.
sources.caution: Do not infer that “provincial” in geographic scope means a ministry subsidiary.

sources.title: Our governance structure
sources.extract: FNHA, FNHC, FNHDA and Tripartite Committee roles; 2011-10-13 framework agreement; relationship agreements and reports.
sources.caution: Model collaboration, governance and program transfer explicitly rather than drawing one provincial parent-child tree.
sources.locator: Tripartite framework agreement and Relationship agreement

sources.title: Transition and transformation
sources.extract: Phased 2013 transfer: July 2 policy/planning and headquarters functions; October 1 regionally delivered programs.
sources.caution: Some FAQ text preserves earlier future-looking plans. Seed events use the page’s completed-transfer chronology, not stale target wording.

sources.title: B.C. Symbols
sources.extract: 1960 flag adoption; coat of arms grant on 1987-10-15; symbol-use guidance and protocol@gov.bc.ca.
sources.caution: Symbol adoption is not the introduction date of a ministry logo system. The page restricts arms/shield/seal use; downloadable artwork does not imply alteration rights.

sources.title: BC Timber Sales
sources.extract: Current remit, linked offices, policy updates and modern organizational context.
sources.caution: This reviewed page did not establish the start date of the earlier BCTS mark. Do not infer that date from the website update date.

sources.title: BC Sessional Papers collection route
sources.extract: Potential digital collection entry point for retrieving the reports identified in catalogues and indexes.
sources.caution: The page exposed only an application shell in this browsing session. Collection coverage and downloadable items were not verified here.

sources.title: B.C. Government Publications Search Portal
sources.extract: Official portal linked by the Library for its digital B.C. government publications.
sources.caution: Route verified from the Library index; individual search results have not been harvested.
